Salesforce just built an operating system for AI agents.

Ahead of Dreamforce 2026, Salesforce did not just launch more AI agents. It unveiled an entirely new architecture for how enterprises run them.

Three moves in one announcement. Job-ready Agentforce agents. An Enterprise AI Harness. And an AI Control Plane — a single governance layer designed to manage agent behavior, data access, and policy enforcement across an entire organization.

This is the shift from deploying AI in pockets to orchestrating it as infrastructure.

For business leaders, the signal is clear. The companies winning in enterprise AI are not the ones with the best individual agent. They are the ones with the best system for governing dozens of agents operating simultaneously across departments.

Salesforce is betting that the orchestration layer — not the model itself — is where enterprise value concentrates long-term. That bet will reshape how CTOs evaluate their AI stacks through 2027 and beyond.
